tool.name: ERGA Assembly Reporting Tool (EAR)
tool.description: compile assembly statistics into an ERGA Assembly Report (PDF)
tool.command:
#import re ## Inputs are linked under descriptive names: file names show in the log and in the ## report data stored in the PDF, where Galaxy's dataset_N.dat names would say nothing. mkdir -p inputs &&
#if $profiling.genomescope ln -s '$profiling.genomescope' 'inputs/genomescope.${profiling.genomescope.ext}' && #end if #if $profiling.smudgeplot ln -s '$profiling.smudgeplot' 'inputs/smudgeplot.${profiling.smudgeplot.ext}' && #end if
#for $i, $asm in enumerate($assemblies, 1) ln -s '$asm.gfastats_nstar' inputs/hap${i}_gfastats.txt && ln -s '$asm.busco_short' inputs/hap${i}_busco.txt && #if $asm.fcs_gx ln -s '$asm.fcs_gx' inputs/hap${i}_fcs_gx.txt && #end if #if $asm.blobplot ln -s '$asm.blobplot' 'inputs/hap${i}_blobplot.${asm.blobplot.ext}' && #end if #if $asm.merqury_spectra_cn ln -s '$asm.merqury_spectra_cn' 'inputs/hap${i}_spectra-cn.${asm.merqury_spectra_cn.ext}' && #end if #if $asm.merqury_spectra_cn_hist ln -s '$asm.merqury_spectra_cn_hist' inputs/hap${i}_spectra-cn.hist && #end if #end for
#if $kmer.mode == 'collections' ## rebuild the Merqury output folder from the collections (element identifier = file ## name without extension); make_EAR.py then finds and matches everything itself mkdir -p merqury && #for $f in $kmer.qv_files #set $name = re.sub('[^A-Za-z0-9_.+-]', '_', str($f.element_identifier)) ln -s '$f' 'merqury/${name}.qv' && #end for #for $f in $kmer.stats_files #set $name = re.sub('[^A-Za-z0-9_.+-]', '_', str($f.element_identifier)) ln -s '$f' 'merqury/${name}.stats' && #end for #if $kmer.png_files #for $f in $kmer.png_files #set $name = re.sub('[^A-Za-z0-9_.+-]', '_', str($f.element_identifier)) ln -s '$f' 'merqury/${name}.png' && #end for #end if #if $kmer.hist_files #for $f in $kmer.hist_files #set $name = re.sub('[^A-Za-z0-9_.+-]', '_', str($f.element_identifier)) ln -s '$f' 'merqury/${name}.hist' && #end for #end if #else if $kmer.mode == 'files' #if $kmer.merqury_qv ln -s '$kmer.merqury_qv' inputs/merqury.qv && #end if #if $kmer.merqury_completeness ln -s '$kmer.merqury_completeness' inputs/merqury.completeness.stats && #end if #if $kmer.merqury_spectra_asm ln -s '$kmer.merqury_spectra_asm' 'inputs/merqury.spectra-asm.${kmer.merqury_spectra_asm.ext}' && #end if #if $kmer.merqury_spectra_cn_combined ln -s '$kmer.merqury_spectra_cn_combined' 'inputs/merqury.spectra-cn.${kmer.merqury_spectra_cn_combined.ext}' && #end if #end if
## alignment plots keep their dataset names: the report prints them as captions #set $alignments = [] #if $curation.alignment_png #for $k, $png in enumerate($curation.alignment_png, 1) #set $name = re.sub('[^A-Za-z0-9_.+-]', '_', str($png.element_identifier)) #if not $name.lower().endswith('.' + $png.ext) #set $name = $name + '.' + $png.ext #end if mkdir -p inputs/alignment_${k} && ln -s '$png' 'inputs/alignment_${k}/$name' && #silent $alignments.append('inputs/alignment_%s/%s' % ($k, $name)) #end for #end if
python '$__tool_directory__/make_EAR.py' --yaml '$ear_yaml' #if $alignments --alignment_png '${",".join($alignments)}' #end if $output_options.no_image_compression ; ret=\$? ; cat EAR_*.log > '$log' ; [ \$ret -eq 0 ] && mv ./*_EAR.pdf '$EAR_pdf'

data types left empty are skipped #set $data_entries = [] #for $d in $sequencing.data #if str($d.type).strip() #silent $data_entries.append($d) #end if #end for #if $data_entries DATA: #for $d in $data_entries #set $gbp = str($d.gbp).strip() #if $gbp and $gbp != 'None' - $yq(str($d.type).strip()): $yq($gbp) #else - $yq(str($d.type).strip()): "" #end if #end for #end if #if $profiling.genomescope or $profiling.smudgeplot PROFILING: #if $profiling.genomescope genomescope: inputs/genomescope.${profiling.genomescope.ext} #end if #if $profiling.smudgeplot smudgeplot: inputs/smudgeplot.${profiling.smudgeplot.ext} #end if #end if ASSEMBLIES: #for $i, $asm in enumerate($assemblies, 1) hap${i}: gfastats_nstar: inputs/hap${i}_gfastats.txt busco_short: inputs/hap${i}_busco.txt #if $asm.fcs_gx fcs_gx: inputs/hap${i}_fcs_gx.txt #end if #if $asm.blobplot blobplot: inputs/hap${i}_blobplot.${asm.blobplot.ext} #end if #if str($asm.pretext_temp_link).strip() pretext_temp_link: $yq(str($asm.pretext_temp_link).strip()) #end if #if $asm.merqury_spectra_cn merqury_spectra_cn: inputs/hap${i}_spectra-cn.${asm.merqury_spectra_cn.ext} #end if #if $asm.merqury_spectra_cn_hist merqury_spectra_cn_hist: inputs/hap${i}_spectra-cn.hist #end if ## param.name: tolid
param.label: ToLID
param.help: e.g. mEleMax1. Checked against the ToLID registry: the report is not produced for a ToLID the registry does not know. Leave empty if there is none.

param.name: species
param.label: Species name
param.help: Scientific name, e.g. Elephas maximus. Used to look up the taxonomy and the expected genome traits in GoaT.

validator.message: Enter the species name (it cannot contain / or \).

expand.name: sex
expand.label: Sample sex
expand.help: Expected sex or karyotype of the sample, e.g. XX, XY, X0, ZW, unknown. Compared (case-insensitive) with the observed sex.

repeat.name: data
repeat.title: Data type
repeat.help: One entry per data type used for the assembly.

param.name: type
param.label: Data type
param.help: e.g. HiFi, ONT, ONT UL, Hi-C, Omni-C, Pore-C, Illumina. HiFi, ONT, Hi-C and Pore-C/CiFi are checked against the EBP read-depth recommendations; other types are shown in Gbp only.

param.name: gbp
param.label: Read amount (Gbp)
param.help: Bases used for the assembly, after any filtering; several libraries of one type added up. Coverage is derived from it and the assembly size. Leave empty if not known.

param.name: genomescope
param.label: GenomeScope plot
param.help: e.g. the linear plot of the GenomeScope tool

repeat.name: assemblies
repeat.title: Assembly
repeat.help: One entry per haplotype or assembly, in order: the first is reported as hap1, the second as hap2, and so on (a primary/alternate pair is hap1 and hap2).

param.name: gfastats_nstar
param.label: gfastats report
param.help: Output of gfastats with --nstar-report ('Genome assembly statistics' in the Galaxy gfastats tool), tabular or plain text

param.name: busco_short
param.label: BUSCO short summary or compleasm summary

param.name: fcs_gx
param.label: FCS-GX action report
param.help: The 'Action report' of NCBI FCS-GX, not the taxonomy report. The flagged sequences are counted.

param.name: blobplot
param.label: Blob plot
param.help: PNG or SVG, e.g. the SVG of the BlobToolKit tool

param.name: pretext_temp_link
param.label: Web link to the Pretext Hi-C contact map
param.help: A link to the .pretext file or to a web folder, e.g. copied from the download button of the dataset

param.name: merqury_spectra_cn
param.label: K-mer copy-number spectrum plot of this assembly
param.help: Merqury/MerquryFK <prefix>.<assembly>.spectra-cn plot. Not needed with Merqury output collections, which already contain it (if given, it replaces the one found there).

param.name: merqury_spectra_cn_hist
param.label: K-mer copy-number histogram of this assembly
param.help: Merqury <prefix>.<assembly>.spectra-cn.hist, used to compute the k-mer false duplications. Not needed with Merqury output collections that include the histograms.

param.name: mode
param.label: K-mer analysis (QV, k-mer completeness, spectra)
param.help: One Merqury or MerquryFK run covering all assemblies above

param.name: qv_files
param.label: Merqury 'QV stats' collection
param.help: The summary <prefix>.qv is found in it and its assemblies are matched to the haplotypes by size

param.name: stats_files
param.label: Merqury 'stats' collection
param.help: Contains <prefix>.completeness.stats

param.name: hist_files
param.label: Merqury 'histograms' collection
param.help: Contains the <prefix>.<assembly>.spectra-cn.hist files used to compute the k-mer false duplications

param.name: merqury_qv
param.label: Summary QV file
param.help: Merqury/MerquryFK <prefix>.qv with one line per assembly, not the per-scaffold <prefix>.<assembly>.qv

param.name: merqury_spectra_asm
param.label: Spectra-asm plot
param.help: <prefix>.spectra-asm plot

param.name: merqury_spectra_cn_combined
param.label: Copy-number spectrum plot of all assemblies combined
param.help: <prefix>.spectra-cn plot. The plot of each assembly is given with that assembly above.

expand.name: pipeline
expand.label: Pipelines and methods
expand.help: Free text, e.g. 'Hifiasm v0.25 Hi-C mode, YaHS default. All assembled in Galaxy'. Line breaks are kept.

param.name: obs_haploid_num
param.label: Observed haploid number
param.help: The haploid chromosome number n as a whole number. It drives the chromosome-scale checks.

param.name: obs_ploidy
param.label: Observed ploidy
param.help: e.g. 2. Also used for the read depth per haplotype.

expand.name: obs_sex
expand.label: Observed sex
expand.help: e.g. XX, XY, X0, ZW, unknown

expand.name: curation_notes
expand.label: Curation notes
expand.help: About the curation, plastids, the sample (e.g. low input, pooled), etc. Shown as 'Comments' under Curator notes.

param.name: alignment_png
param.label: Alignment plots
param.help: e.g. a D-GENIES dot plot or a SyRI plot between haplotypes. The dataset names are printed as captions.

param.name: no_image_compression
param.label: Embed plots without compression
param.help: By default plots are flattened, downsampled to 300 dpi at their printed size and reduced to 256 colours, which is visually lossless for these plots and gives a smaller PDF.

param.name: curation_notes
param.value: No contaminants left; "scaffold_5" removed: see FCS-GX

tool.help:
.. class:: infomark
**What it does**
The **ERGA Assembly Reporting Tool (EAR)** compiles the results of an assembly pipeline into the PDF report used by the `ERGA Sequencing and Assembly Committee <https://github.com/ERGA-consortium/EARs>`_ to review genome assemblies before they are submitted to ENA. The report has:
- the species, its taxonomy and the expected genome traits (genome size, haploid number, ploidy) from `GoaT <https://goat.genomehubs.org>`_, next to the observed ones - the EBP quality metric of each assembly (e.g. 6.C.Q40) and the checks that are automatically flagged as likely below the Earth BioGenome Project (EBP) standards - a quality metrics table per haplotype: gfastats statistics, QV, k-mer completeness, k-mer false duplications and BUSCO/compleasm scores - k-mer spectra, FCS-GX counts, blob plots, alignment plots, GenomeScope/Smudgeplot plots (each plot can be PNG or SVG) - the sequencing data with their read depth, the methods and the curation notes
The tool queries GoaT and the `ToLID registry <https://id.tol.sanger.ac.uk>`_ over the internet. A ToLID that the registry does not know stops the report; when the services cannot be reached, the report is still made, with NA for the values from GoaT.
-----
**Inputs**
Only the species, one assembly (gfastats report and BUSCO/compleasm summary) and the observed haploid number are required. Everything else that is left empty is shown as NA in the report, and noted in the log.
*Assemblies* are reported in the order given: the first as hap1, the second as hap2, and so on (up to 4).
- *gfastats report*: run gfastats in "Genome assembly statistics (--nstar-report)" mode; the L90 values come from that report. - *BUSCO short summary* or the *compleasm summary*. - *FCS-GX action report* (optional): the flagged sequences are counted.
*K-mer analysis*: one Merqury (or MerquryFK) run that covers all assemblies.
- **Merqury output collections**: give the 'QV stats' and 'stats' collections of the Galaxy Merqury tool, and optionally its 'plots' and 'histograms' collections. The assemblies in the Merqury results are matched to the haplotypes by size, so their order does not matter. The histograms are needed for the k-mer false duplications. - **Individual files**: give the summary QV file and the completeness file (and the plots, if wanted). This works for Merqury and MerquryFK (whose 'Error and qv of each assembly as a whole' output is the summary QV file). The plot and the copy-number histogram of each assembly are given with that assembly.
*Sequencing data*: one entry per data type with its read amount in Gbp. The coverage is the read amount divided by the size of the largest assembly; with the observed ploidy, it is checked per haplotype against the EBP recommendations (HiFi >15x, ONT >25x, Hi-C >25x, Pore-C/CiFi >10x).
-----
**Outputs**
- The EAR **PDF**. All values it shows (and the log of the run) are also stored as JSON in the PDF metadata, with a Report ID that fingerprints them. - The **log** of the run, with every input that was missing or could not be used, how the Merqury results were matched, and how each check was computed.
